text: Purpose: Pins core package - handles versioning, caching, distribution. Architecture (Transparent Users): - Public Hub: pkgdown-served board https://flmnh-ai.github.io/petrographer/pins/ - Consumed via board_url(), served pkgdown/assets/pins/ repo - Updated maintainers, auto-deployed via GitHub Pages - Local Dataset Board: .petrographer/datasets/ project root (auto-created) - dataset pins stored - Users reference dataset_id train_model() - Local Model Board: .petrographer/models/ project root (auto-created) - train_model() automatically pins trained models - Users load from_pretrained(model_id, board = "local") - Custom Boards: Advanced users can specify board_folder("path") either datasets models Board Separation: Datasets models use separate boards allow identical names without collision: Key Functions: - from_pretrained(model_id, board = NULL) - Load model (NULL = hub, “local” = model board) - pin_model(model_dir, model_id, board) - Pin model board - pin_dataset(data_dir, dataset_id, board) - Pin dataset board - list_models(board) / list_trained_models() - List available models - list_datasets(board) - List available datasets - model_info(model_id, board) - Show model metadata - get_training_dataset(model_id, board) - Retrieve exact dataset version used train model Internal Helpers: - .get_dataset_board() - Returns local dataset board (exported) - .get_model_board() - Returns local model board (exported) Dataset Version Tracking (Reproducibility): Models automatically track exact dataset version used training. ensures reproducibility allows retrieve training data later: dataset version ID (e.g., "20251013T143943Z-8329a") stored model metadata used retrieve correct pins version. works even dataset updated since training. Maintainer Workflow (Publishing Hub): 1. Pin model: pin_model(model_dir, model_id, hub_board) 2. Update manifest: pins::write_board_manifest(hub_board) 3. Rebuild pkgdown: pkgdown::build_site() 4. Commit & push GitHub 5. Model appears hub deployment Refactored (2025-10): Separated datasets models different boards prevent namespace collisions allow names related datasets/models. Training auto-pins local boards.
